labels.title: Add a label
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Pick whether the initialization code should be generated and automatically called at startup.

oneOf.title: Callable
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated and called in peripheral initialization.

oneOf.title: Generated
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated but not called in peripheral initialization.

actions.message: It is recommended to use the HSP Engine middleware instead of configuring HAL. The firmware must be loaded into the dedicated HSP memory to use most HAL functionalities. The HSP Engine middleware automatically loads this firmware.
To use HSP, either disable the D-Cache or configure the MPU to make the HSP SRAM non-cacheable.

spe_smart_clocking.title: SPE smart clocking
spe_smart_clocking.description: If enabled, the SPE is not clocked in WFE mode.

mmc_smart_clocking.title: MMC smart clocking
mmc_smart_clocking.description: If enabled, the memory is not clocked if there is no access.

controller_smart_clocking.title: Controller smart clocking
controller_smart_clocking.description: If enabled, the parts of HSP CTRL block are not clocked if inactive.

bram_conflict_count.title: BRAM conflict access counter
bram_conflict_count.description: If enabled, BRAM conflict access counting is activated to monitor CPU/HSP BRAM arbitration conflicts.

bram_latency.title: BRAM latency
bram_latency.description: When the SPE and the application both request access to the BRAM, the BRAM latency defines the maximum number of clock cycles before the application can access it. After this time interval, the SPE is no longer given priority.
